newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Aztar rating, estimates cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Aztar rating, estimates cut.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers analyst Bruce Turner cut his rating on Aztar Corp to hold from buy after the company late on Thursday said it would report third quarter earnings at about breakeven levels versus Salomon's estimate of $0.24 a share.
-- In written research, Turner cut his full year 1996 earnings estimate to breakeven from a profit of $0.40 a share, 1997 to $0.15 from $0.70 and 1998 to $0.20 from $0.80.

-- Turner had expected Aztar's newly renovated Tropicana Casino and Resort in Atlantic City (formerly TropWorld) to post a strong operating performance after completing an expansion, but he now expects cash flow to decrease.
-- Shares were trading down 1-1/4 at 8-5/8 in late morning exchange activity.
